name: The seller-pays override cannot be approved by its requester
title: SC-08-05-07 The seller-pays override cannot be approved by its requester
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a seller-pays override request is pending
When its requester tries to approve it
Then it is refused and the request stays pending
